narration: The input image is first processed by the CLIP visual encoder to extract spatial feature map F_v.
Concurrently, the category text prompt is passed through the CLIP text encoder to generate language embeddings F_l.
The vision and language features are fused in the V-L Correlation module to form cross-modal correlation tensor C_v&l.
Inside the ESC-Block, the Pseudo Prompt Generator transforms the correlation tensor into point and mask prompts.
The SAM Block leverages these pseudo prompts alongside visual features to generate refined feature map F'_v.
The VLF Block integrates refined visual features, original correlation, and text embeddings to update correlation tensor C'_v&l.
Finally, after N iterative refinements through the ESC-Block, the decoder outputs the predicted segmentation mask M.
